question: Why can the explicit AT-SPI GrabFocus call succeed while GetState remains unfocused on the layout button after modal cancellation and list selection?
method: Run the preserved keyboard oracle's canvas case on the same committed native binary. Record explicit accessibility state and X11 focus before and after focus requests. On a failure only, issue one Space key to observe the already requested focus target's actual activation, then stop the diagnostic without claiming acceptance.

criteria.unavailable: An explicit query error remains unavailable; it is never evidence of no focus.
criteria.external_focus: If X11 focus leaves the owned editor, investigate activation and ownership.
criteria.state_mismatch: If X11 focus stays with the owned editor and Space activates the requested control despite explicit false FOCUSED, inspect GTK export and widget/window focus distinctions.
criteria.wrong_activation: If another control activates, inspect the producer focus lifecycle.
criteria.no_failure: An unchanged pass is inconclusive and does not establish a fix.

limits: Use the existing unprivileged ir4runner ext4/Xvfb/DBus laboratory only. Keep source, expected scenes, acceptance deadlines and other native oracles unchanged. Preserve all diagnostic attempts and binary/script identities.
